title: Barbell Back Squat
description: 1. Set the bar across the upper back, grip it securely, step clear of the rack, and brace with the feet slightly wider than the hips. 2. Sit the hips down and back while the knees track over the toes and the chest remains lifted. 3. Drive through the whole foot to stand, keep the spine neutral, and re-rack only after finishing the set.
